scenes.text: Every week arrives the same way. Meeting notes, email threads, a screenshot somebody sent at eleven at night, a PDF nobody read. The action items are in there somewhere. Finding them is the job before the job.
scenes.spoken: Every week arrives the same way. Meeting notes, email threads, a screenshot somebody sent at eleven at night, a PDF nobody read. The action items are in there somewhere. Finding them is the job before the job.

scenes.text: Week Prep is one HTML file. You drop the week’s raw material into a folder, open the file in Chrome, and click Ingest. Claude reads everything, pulls out the items that are actually yours, tags them, and writes a plain JSON file right back into that folder.
scenes.spoken: Week Prep is one H T M L file. You drop the week’s raw material into a folder, open the file in Chrome, and click Ingest. Claude reads everything, pulls out the items that are actually yours, tags them, and writes a plain JSON file right back into that folder.

scenes.text: Here is the result. The week at a glance: what’s open, what’s high priority, what’s due in the next seven days. Earlier weeks sit underneath as cards.
scenes.spoken: Here is the result. The week at a glance: what’s open, what’s high priority, what’s due in the next seven days. Earlier weeks sit underneath as cards.

scenes.text: Every item carries a priority, a plan day, a theme, and a project. Expand one and you get the context: which meeting it came from, and why it landed on your list.
scenes.spoken: Every item carries a priority, a plan day, a theme, and a project. Expand one and you get the context: which meeting it came from, and why it landed on your list.

scenes.text: Unfinished work doesn’t vanish on Friday. Anything still open rolls into next week automatically, with a badge that shows where it came from and how long it has been waiting.
scenes.spoken: Unfinished work doesn’t vanish on Friday. Anything still open rolls into next week automatically, with a badge that shows where it came from and how long it has been waiting.

scenes.text: Projects pull their items together across weeks. One button packages everything that’s open into a brief you can paste into any AI chat.
scenes.spoken: Projects pull their items together across weeks. One button packages everything that’s open into a brief you can paste into any AI chat.

scenes.text: There’s a built-in assistant that sees the whole week. It can propose changes: plan days, priorities, new items, subtasks. But every proposal is a card. Nothing touches your list until you click Apply.
scenes.spoken: There’s a built-in assistant that sees the whole week. It can propose changes: plan days, priorities, new items, subtasks. But every proposal is a card. Nothing touches your list until you click Apply.

scenes.text: Dark mode, search, sortable columns. And it all saves back to a JSON file in your folder, so it syncs wherever your folder syncs.
scenes.spoken: Dark mode, search, sortable columns. And it all saves back to a JSON file in your folder, so it syncs wherever your folder syncs.

scenes.text: One HTML file. Your files stay in your folder. The only network call goes to Claude, and only when you ask. Week Prep. Open source, on GitHub.
